review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants with identical metadata). Both items accurately measure basic vocabulary knowledge and vocabulary-in-context; their topic, label and module are appropriate.

Part 2/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two identical context-only variants). Both items measure straightforward reading comprehension skills and their supplied metadata are appropriate; no revisions required.

Part 3/5: Reviewed 2 items (each with two context-only variants) for P5 English reading. Both items assess readers' ability to infer meaning/attitude from brief textual cues. The supplied topic and module accurately describe the measured skill; labels are appropriate. No substantive metadata changes required.

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items accurately assess text-cohesion skills (reference and use of connectors). Metadata fields are appropriate and educationally coherent. Recommend no changes.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 items (english-reading-P5-8-0, english-reading-P5-9-0). Both items' metadata accurately describe the skill tested; no substantive changes required.

reviews.reason: The item asks for the meaning of the word 'considerate', which tests vocabulary/word-meaning recognition. The topic 'Vocabulary', the label 'Vocabulary', and module '基礎掌握' correctly describe the skill and difficulty.

The item asks the student to identify which action exemplifies the adjective 'considerate' in a context—this is vocabulary-in-context/word-in-context. The topic 'Vocabulary', label 'Word in context', and module '基礎掌握' appropriately describe the skill and difficulty.

The item requires locating a specific time-related detail from a short notice and applying it to choose the correct action. The label 'Detail finding' and the topic 'Reading details and main idea' correctly describe this skill; the module '理解與應用' (comprehension and application) is also appropriate.

The item asks students to identify the main purpose of a short explanatory text (central idea/purpose). The label 'Main idea', the topic 'Reading details and main idea', and the module '理解與應用' accurately reflect the assessed skill.

The stem asks the student to infer motivation/importance from Jason's action; this is standard reading inference. The label 'Inference', topic 'Reading inference' and module '情境推理' correctly name the skill.

The question asks for the writer's likely attitude/tone based on a positive phrase; this is an inference about writer attitude. The label 'Writer attitude', topic 'Reading inference' and module '情境推理' are appropriate.

The question asks students to identify the antecedent of the pronoun 'It', which is exactly a reference/cohesion skill. The label 'Reference word', topic 'Text cohesion: reference and connectors', and module '理解與應用' correctly describe the measured skill.
The item requires selecting a linking word that expresses a result. This is a connectors (text cohesion) item. The provided label, topic and module correctly reflect the assessed skill.

The item asks the student to identify the primary purpose of a short informational webpage (author's purpose / reader’s next action). The label 'Reading purpose' and the topic 'Integrated reading: purpose and evidence' correctly describe the skill. The module '理解與應用' (comprehension and application) is appropriate for this task.

The item requires selecting a textual detail that supports an inference about Jason's attitude (finding supporting evidence). The label 'Identify supporting evidence' and the topic 'Integrated reading: purpose and evidence' accurately describe the measured skill. The module '理解與應用' is appropriate.
